name: proxycurl
label: Proxycurl
description: Enrich LinkedIn people and company profiles with Proxycurl.

token.label: Proxycurl API Key
token.description:
To use Proxycurl:
1. Sign in to your Proxycurl account at https://nubela.co/proxycurl.
2. Open your dashboard and copy your API key.
3. Paste the API key here.

Authentication note:
- Proxycurl's public SDK/docs show Bearer token authorization for API requests.

get_person_profile.label: Get Person Profile
get_person_profile.description: Fetch a LinkedIn person profile from Proxycurl.

linkedin_profile_url.label: LinkedIn Profile URL
linkedin_profile_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates

get_company_profile.label: Get Company Profile
get_company_profile.description: Fetch a LinkedIn company profile from Proxycurl.

url.label: LinkedIn Company URL
url.description: LinkedIn company URL, for example https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/

search_people.label: Search People
search_people.description: Search for people in Proxycurl using lightweight keyword filters.

country.label: Country
country.description: Optional country filter, for example us, gb, or sg.

headline.label: Headline Keywords
headline.description: Optional keywords expected in the person headline.

summary_keywords.label: Summary Keywords
summary_keywords.description: Optional keywords expected in the summary/about section.

lookup_person_email.label: Lookup Person Email
lookup_person_email.description: Lookup the work email address for a LinkedIn person profile.

linkedin_profile_url.label: LinkedIn Profile URL
linkedin_profile_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL to enrich.

callback_url.label: Callback URL
callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for async completion callbacks from Proxycurl.
